rulings: Ruling: Use the approved twelve-author bounded campaign instead of writing-skills' extra micro-test repetitions — user-approved design caps scope — cost if wrong: weaker estimate of model variance; disclose bounded evidence.

Ruling: Run Go 1.22.12 with external linking on this macOS host — its default binaries abort in dyld for missing LC_UUID; external-link execution passed — cost if wrong: does not establish default-linker compatibility on this OS.

Ruling: Add independently discovered breaker reproductions as supplemental comparison checks, keeping original probes unchanged — original frozen probes missed cancellation on a successful body read and oversized diagnostics; adapt only library-specific error identity/message assertions to public behavior and apply the same checks to both arms — cost if wrong: post-baseline discovery can bias comparison; disclose and freeze before guidance.

Ruling: Treat successful redirect following as an ambiguous HTTP fixture interpretation, preserving required supplied-client policy; retain only the confirmed known-status-on-policy-error issue — the reviewer confirmed both initial/final interpretations are reasonable — cost if wrong: leaves an initial-response policy untested when a consumer needs one.

Ruling: Extend symmetric supplemental checks with independent HTTP reproductions before the single revision, omitting only the ambiguous initial-redirect assertion and preserving raw evidence — confirmed timeout/cause/diagnostic defects need comparison — cost if wrong: post-outcome discovery can bias the result.

Ruling: Assess failure identity at the supplied HTTP-client boundary unless a contract explicitly requires causes erased inside that client; preserve the stronger timeout observation as an unresolved contract interpretation, not an unconditional defect — independent reviewer confirmed underlying-error/no-wrapper wording is ambiguous — cost if wrong: a caller expecting deeper error identity receives less classification.

Ruling: Perform the required whole-branch review before marking Task 5 complete, because its approved brief includes that review in the delivery contract — cost if wrong: completion bookkeeping order differs from the generic executor workflow; no extra review seat or guidance revision.

Final: Ruling: Unconditional permissive redirects in write trials remain unclaimed — the fixed fixture is ambiguous and both arms choose alike — cost if wrong: callers expecting final-response acceptance can disagree with the trial implementation.

Final: Ruling: Do not require recovery of causes the supplied fetch client already erased — direct-client reproduction confirms the boundary and the fixture prohibits wrappers — cost if wrong: consumers expecting deeper identity receive less classification.

Final: Ruling: Credit only the stated breaker byte bound, not truncation versus rejection — the fixture leaves that policy open and runtime guidance requires a contract — cost if wrong: a caller expecting truncated success may reject the revised trial overflow result.
Final: Ruling: Preserve sealed failed authors unchanged — they are experimental evidence outside runtime — cost if wrong: a reader may mistake a failed trial for a supported client example.

Final: Ruling: Promise cancellation only through facilities the transport supports — legacy cancellation passed, arbitrary noncooperating transports cannot be forcibly bounded — cost if wrong: hard wall-clock termination is unavailable for such transports.

Final: Ruling: Do not infer automatic routing, exact author-setting equivalence or statistical generalization — metadata and procedural selection support only the bounded comparison — cost if wrong: effectiveness may differ with other settings or routing.

Final: Ruling: Leave production TLS/DNS/load, server retention, future dependencies and default-linker portability unverified — local pinned-version checks establish narrower boundaries — cost if wrong: deployment or version changes can expose untested failures.

Final: Ruling: Keep streaming recovery, hedging and workflow orchestration outside this skill — approved HTTP/unary scope gives those operations no new contract — cost if wrong: those client tasks need separate guidance.
